An '''unnamed [[Medic/Legends|medic]]''' who served on the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Hospital ship/Legends|hospital ship]] ''[[Mercy (hospital ship)|Mercy]]''; assigned to the special [[Ward 114]].

==History==
This [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]] joined the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. By [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]] he served on the [[Hospital ship/Legends|hospital ship]] ''[[Mercy (hospital ship)|Mercy]]'', specifically the special [[Ward 114]] reserved for [[Alliance Special Operations/Legends|SpecOps]] and [[Alliance Intelligence/Legends|Intelligence]] [[Agent/Legends|agents]] who deserved high-priority medical treatment. Because of his capacity, he maintained some certain security measures like checking everyone's [[Identichip/Legends|I.D. card]] on his reader.<ref name="RA" />

In that year, he received a [[Kyle Katarn|patient]] from SpecOps. While he would deserve high priority treatment, his files were "borderline priority" because of his questionable past; he was told that he was affiliated with the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], and therefore would rather deserve more primitive treatment in the lower decks. Furthermore, his log has no mission statement, meaning that he was not in assignment [[Mission to Nar Shaddaa (5 ABY)|when he was wounded]]. Despite these details, he decided to treat him in a [[Bacta tank/Legends|bacta tank]], hoping he did the right thing, even though many patients waited in line: the ''Mercy'' was receiving casualties from [[Shackel]].<ref name="RAAD">[[Dark Forces: Rebel Agent (audio drama)|''Dark Forces: Rebel Agent'' audio drama]]</ref>

About twelve [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]] later, he was updating some charts for [[Lieutenant Commander/Legends|Lieutenant Commander]] [[Nidifer]] when a woman entered requiring to see [[Kyle Katarn]]; the medic promptly asked for her I.D. and seeing that she was agent [[Jan Ors]], he pointed towards the hatch where [[Bacta tank 23]] was, saying that he would be out later that day.<ref name="RA" /> He pointed out that he was alive thanks to whoever brought him just in time, otherwise he would not survive his injury. Upon Ors saying that she did it, he said that the patient should owe his life to her. He also expressed his doubts about the patient, mentioning the bizarre details in his profile; Ors ensured him that Katarn did a lot about the Alliance, and (lied that) he was in an unofficial mission undercover, explaining the empty mission statement.<ref name="RAAD" /> A few minutes later he watched her leaving the ward in haste, and returned to his work.<ref name="RA">''[[Dark Forces: Rebel Agent]]''</ref>

Indeed, Katarn was soon released from the tank and put on a medical bed. Unknown to everyone, Katarn experienced a [[Force vision/Legends|vision]], and was mumbling. The doctor saw that he was coming out of the coma, and thinking that SpecOps would like to be informed, he ordered to alert the Commander.<ref name="RAAD" />

==Personality and traits==
The medic was balding and a bit overweight; when Jan Ors met him he looked tired from doing the job assigned by Nidifer.<ref name="RA" />

Because of his position in the special Ward 114 he frequently encountered [[Spy/Legends|spies]] whom he considered jumpy, and was careful when having to do with one, being prompt and keeping a neutral voice. He considered himself an expert in recognising one, from their overall style, expression and attire.<ref name="RA" />

He felt lonely and thought of his patients more fortunate than him in that matter; he believed that in case he should be in their place nobody would cry over him.<ref name="RA" />

==Behind the scenes==
In the [[Dark Forces: Rebel Agent (audio drama)|''Dark Forces: Rebel Agent'' audio drama]] [[Jeff Gadbois]] is credited as "Doctor".
